def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # Fix sex label variant (FEMALE -> female)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].replace({'FEMALE': 'female'})
    
    # Convert text numbers to numeric for flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Fix out of range flipper_length_mm (set to NaN if outside 170-235)
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    
    # Fix out of range body_mass_g (values > 6500 likely in wrong unit, divide by 1000)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    
    # Set body_mass_g to NaN if still out of range (2500-6500)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = np.nan
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    # Remove any NaN keys
    result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if pd.notna(k)}
    return result
